games.description: Three solo visits to a survival shooter with crafting, scavenging, and branching dialogue. Sark returns after soft locks, tackles the black-lake boss and giant-filled island, and pushes through to both final choices.

games.description: A brief solo look at megane’s hotel horror game. Sark explores dark corridors and doors with a flashlight, then leaves the unsettling loop unfinished.

games.description: A solo visit to Radion Studios’ Backrooms game. Sark searches keys, vases and disconnected environments, tests the computer and moves on. The unrelated video-watching break is omitted.

games.description: A solo color-key hunt repeatedly runs into trouble with the blue door. Sark stops when the required gold key remains inaccessible and the game will not quit normally.
games.title: Liminal Underground: Creatures Beyond

games.description: Sark pushes through dark liminal spaces, finds a weapon and gets stuck collecting fifty tickets. He returns after collecting the tickets off stream, solves a timed barrel puzzle and explores a flooded shopping area before stopping at another unclear route.
